action.decision_reason: Step 1 requires generate_structures; Monte Carlo remains locked until the GMC-guided discovery cycle is completed, and the baseline GMC field is the only available screened parent.

action.hypothesis: The four highest-ranked single-swap moves toward high GMC path-importance cell [4,3] will most reduce far-field CVaR90, max, and worst-sector flux versus baseline, since they place absorber on the dominant leakage path while removing low-sensitivity absorbers.
action.expected_observation: Cached GMC risk, far-field mean/CVaR90/max, and worst-sector values for these four candidates, plus gmc_screened count rising toward the minimum batch gate.
action.decision_reason: Prior screen_gmc was rejected for exceeding the per-call genvr budget of 4 new evaluations; reissue with exactly the top four proposal-score candidates to begin the GMC-guided discovery cycle within budget.

action.hypothesis: Breeding from the two best GMC-screened parents, moving remaining low-sensitivity corner absorbers toward the high-importance near-source cells (notably [4,3]/[3,4]/[2,3]/[3,2]), will further cut far-field CVaR90, max, and worst-sector flux while capping hot sector 4.
action.expected_observation: A fresh batch of GMC-guided, unevaluated descendants of 20d0b63a8068 and fed6d69cffdf flagged gmc_guided_generation true, ready for GMC rescreening and progress toward the guided-discovery gate.
action.decision_reason: gmc_guided_generation_needed is true and the required discovery cycle (generate -> GMC screen -> regenerate from GMC field -> GMC rescreen) demands regeneration from GMC-screened parents; this builds the gmc-guided structures needed for the 4-guided/10-screened gate. A per-call cap of 4 GMC evaluations also favors generating first.

action.expected_observation: Cached GMC risk and far-field CVaR90/max/worst-sector metrics for these four GMC-guided candidates, raising gmc_screened and gmc_guided_and_screened counts toward the 10-screened/4-guided gate.
action.decision_reason: Six GMC-guided designs await screening and the verifier requires a GMC rescreen of regenerated structures before MC; per-call GMC budget is 4, so screen the four highest-proposal-score guided descendants to satisfy the guided cycle without exceeding budget.

action.hypothesis: Rank-2 GMC-guided descendants that delete the lowest-sensitivity absorber cells ([1,5], [5,1], [4,4], [5,5]) and place material on high path-importance cells [3,4]/[4,3] will match or beat the current best GMC risk (0.0832) on far-field mean, CVaR90, max, and worst-sector flux.
action.expected_observation: Cached GMC risk and far-field mean/CVaR90/max/worst-sector metrics for these four guided candidates, raising gmc_screened from 8 to 12 and passing the minimum-10 GMC batch gate before any Monte Carlo.
action.decision_reason: GMC-guided cycle requires rescreening regenerated structures, the batch gate (10 screened) is still unmet, four guided designs remain unevaluated, and the per-call GMC cap is 4; selected candidates remove the least-sensitive absorber cells per the GMC physics diagnosis.

action.hypothesis: The best GMC-screened candidate d7d960548ee7 (GMC risk 0.0832, lowest far_mean 1.66e-4, CVaR90 6.72e-4, max 1.17e-3, worst-sector 3.17e-4) will show a statistically significant far-field reduction versus baseline under unbiased Monte Carlo, confirming the GMC prediction.
action.expected_observation: Analog and GMC-weight-window MC far-field means, CVaR90, max, and worst-sector with 95% intervals across 4 replicates of 5000 histories (20000 total), and GMC-vs-MC consistency within z=2, satisfying the certification contract for this candidate.
action.decision_reason: GMC batch gate (12 >= 10) and guided gate (8 >= 4) are passed and no MC has been run; step 7 should begin physical certification on the single best GMC design within the 80000 root-history budget rather than spend the last GMC slots.

arguments.summary: GMC-guided design d7d960548ee7 (parent fed6d69cffdf, swapping low-sensitivity absorbers [3,5],[5,5] onto high path-importance cells [3,4],[4,3]) was certified under unbiased global Monte Carlo: far-field candidate/baseline = 0.1073 (89.3% reduction, diff_z = -48.93, 95% intervals separated) and deep far-field 0.7394 (26.1% reduction, diff_z = -6.09), with candidate GMC-vs-MC consistency within |z| < 2. This satisfies the required genvr-cfm-response -> unbiased-mc fidelity chain against the relative-risk threshold of 1.0.

action.hypothesis: The strongest GMC-guided, GMC-screened candidate is the best available design and already passes the independent verifier's far-field reduction and consistency criteria, so no further uncertifiable exploration is warranted.
action.expected_observation: The independent verifier confirms d7d960548ee7 as a verified_improvement given the separated 95% far-field and deep-far-field intervals, consistency z within 2, and a candidate-over-baseline ratio well below 1.0.
action.decision_reason: MC root-history budget is exhausted (80000/80000) and no Monte Carlo certification tool remains available, so any newly generated or GMC-screened structure could never complete the mandatory fidelity chain and be verified. objective.fom_role: verification efficiency only; never the shielding objective
